quote: Buschow et al [19] first determined the entire composition by metallography, thermal analysis and x-ray diffractometry, and found four solution phases (liquid, fcc, bcc and dhcp) and six intermetallic compounds (Al4Pr, Al3Pr, Al2Pr, AlPr, AlPr2 and AlPr3), including an allotropic transformation α_Al4Pr/β_Al4Pr at 965 °C.

paper_citation: Jinfa Liao, Yuehui Liao, Hang Wang, Ligang Zhang, Yue Ma, Thermodynamic optimization of the Ni–Al–Pr ternary system, Mater. Res. Express 6, 086512 (2019).
quote: For the Al11Pr3 phase, the allotropic transformation was included, and the transformation temperature between the α-Al11Pr3 and β-Al11Pr3 phases is 965 °C, which is the same as that in the literature [19].
